name: Lazy Suzy Cafe & Shop
why_included: Strong wifi, roomy airy seating, quiet background music.

name: Variety Coffee (Park Slope)
why_included: Fast wifi, ample sunny seating near Prospect Park.

name: Cafe Flor
why_included: Free WiFi, plenty of outlets, couches, natural light; open until ~9pm weekdays, turns wine bar at night.

name: Ground Central Coffee (8th Ave)
why_included: Solid WiFi, outlets, communal tables plus back room of armchairs; group-friendly.

name: Bibliotheque
why_included: Book-lined cafe; laptops welcome 10am-5pm only, laptop-free evenings when it becomes a wine bar.

name: Haraz Coffee House (Astoria)
why_included: Bright modern Yemeni cafe with plenty of seating; group-friendly.

name: Sunset Park Library
why_included: New 20,000+ sq ft branch opened Nov 2023; reservable meeting rooms and recording studio; open to 8pm Tue/Thu. Group.

name: The Beekman, a Thompson Hotel
why_included: Nine-story atrium lobby with coffee shop, solid Wi-Fi, quiet; non-guests can work without a stay. Some photo-taking foot traffic.

name: Urban Garden Room at One Bryant Park
why_included: Indoor POPS off the lobby with seating areas and coffee shop; Chashama lists 72-person capacity; chess players welcome.

name: Whole Foods Market Union Square (upstairs seating)
why_included: Large upstairs dining area overlooking the park; people work for hours. Customer seating: receipts may be checked when busy.
